liability_cap: Total cumulative liability will not exceed the aggregate amount of fees and expenses owed by PC Financial to Mobimagic for services performed under this Agreement.
risk_explanation: The agreement includes a broad limitation of liability capped at the aggregate fees/expenses owed and excludes consequential damages, which can materially limit recovery for a vendor. Termination is only for material breach with a 30-day cure period and no clear termination-for-convenience right, reducing flexibility. Data protection obligations are stated at a high level without detailed security, audit, or cross-border transfer terms, creating compliance ambiguity.
